title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
tagline: Every light on the house. One very dry turkey.
about: Clark Griswold tries to give his whole family the perfect old-fashioned Christmas.
cue: Serve the turkey when Clark carves his and it collapses.

Griswold Family KitchenNational Lampoon's Christmas VacationEvery light on the house. One very dry turkey.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersEggnog in moose mugsCooked custard eggnog with fresh nutmeg, chilled overnightHow to make it4 eggs80g caster sugar500ml full cream milk200ml thickened cream1 tsp vanilla extract1 whole nutmeg, to grateSeparate the eggs and whisk the yolks with the sugar.Heat the milk and cream, pour over the yolks and stir over low heat to 75°C.Chill overnight.Stir in the vanilla and grate fresh nutmeg on top.Cousin Eddie's RV sausagesCharred kielbasa with slow cooked onions and wholegrain mustard on toothpicksHow to make it500g kielbasa2 brown onions30g butter2 tbsp wholegrain mustardSlice the kielbasa thick on the diagonal and slice the onions.Griddle the sausage until charred.Cook the onions slowly in the butter until soft.Toss together with the mustard and spear on toothpicks.Jelly of the Month Club lime mouldThe lime jelly Aunt Bethany gift-wrapsHow to make itAs written, serves 4A retro lime jelly mould set with crushed pineapple and a creamy whipped layer, turned out wobbling onto a plate with fresh mint.Dissolve two 85g packets lime jelly in 500ml boiling water and stir in 300ml cold water and 1 tbsp lime juice.Pour half into a 1.2L mould and chill 1 hour until set.Chill the other half until thick but not set, then fold through 200ml whipped cream and a drained 440g tin crushed pineapple.Pour over and chill 4 hours.Dip the mould in hot water and turn out.Devilled eggs with paprikaAunt Bethany's grace was the Pledge of Allegiance.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsJuicy roast turkeySalted turkey breast with thyme butter, stuffing and gravy, nothing like Clark'sHow to make it1.5kg turkey breast roast1 tbsp sea salt flakes50g soft butter1 bunch thyme200g stuffing mix1 tbsp plain flour375ml chicken stockRub the turkey with the salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.Push the butter and thyme under the skin.Roast at 170°C until it hits 65°C inside.Rest under foil. Make the stuffing as the packet says.Make gravy from the pan juices with the flour and stock.Griswold glazed hamThe big Griswold family Christmas spreadHow to make itAs written, serves 4Leg ham scored in diamonds, studded with cloves and glazed with brown sugar, pineapple and mustard until sticky, with potato bake and peas.Remove the skin from a 3kg half leg ham, score and stud with cloves.Simmer 150g brown sugar, 200ml pineapple juice and 2 tbsp Dijon for 5 minutes.Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes, glazing every 15 minutes.Layer 1kg sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, 1 sliced onion and 100g cheddar and bake at 180°C for 60 minutes.Serve with 400g buttered peas.SweetsPecan pieCrisp shortcrust with a gooey golden syrup and pecan fillingHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry3 eggs250ml golden syrup100g brown sugar60g butter1 tsp vanilla extract200g pecansLine a tin with the pastry and blind bake.Toast the pecans. Whisk the eggs, golden syrup, sugar, melted butter and vanilla.Stir in the pecans, pour into the case and bake at 170°C until just set.Cool before slicing.DrinksSledding hot chocolateHot milk whisked with dark chocolate, topped with marshmallowsHow to make it1 L full cream milk150g dark chocolate100g marshmallowsChop the chocolate.Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate until frothy.Pour into four mugs and pile marshmallows on top.
